name: Filmare
tagline: Agent sessions as video. Nothing private leaves.
summary: Renders Claude Code and Codex logs as terminal clips, or refuses to export.

highlights.label: FORMATS
highlights.title: Vertical, landscape, square
highlights.text: Renders Claude Code and Codex logs as short clips.

highlights.label: MASKING
highlights.title: Sanitized before render
highlights.text: Secrets, names, paths and tool output never reach the renderer.

highlights.label: GATES
highlights.title: Three leak gates
highlights.text: Text, layout and on-device OCR must all pass, or no file.

highlights.label: LABEL
highlights.title: Replay label on every clip
highlights.text: Burned in with the date: a reconstruction, not a recording.

highlights.label: CUTS
highlights.title: Beats picked by rule
highlights.text: Or choose your own cuts with --cut.

highlights.label: REVIEW
highlights.title: Contact sheet included
highlights.text: Watch every clip before you publish it.

steps.title: Sanitize
steps.text: Copy only what is known safe.
